using ll = long long;
using ld = long double;
using pii = pair<ll, ll>;
template <typename G>
struct triple { G F, S, T; };

struct DSU {
    vector<int> par, sz;
    int comp;
    DSU(int n) : par(n), sz(n, 1), comp(n) {
        iota(par.begin(), par.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int x) {
        return par[x] = (par[x] == x ? x : find(par[x]));
    }
    bool unite(int x, int y) {
        x = find(x), y = find(y);
        if (x == y) return false;
        if (sz[x] > sz[y]) swap(x, y);
        comp -= (sz[x] > 1 && sz[y] > 1);
        comp += (sz[x] == 1 && sz[y] == 1);
        par[x] = y;
        sz[y] += sz[x];
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
#ifdef Adrian
    //freopen("test.txt", "r", stdin);
#else
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(nullptr); cout.tie(nullptr);
#endif

    const int MOD = 1000000007;
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    int result = 1;
    if (k == 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < p - 1; ++i)
            result = (ll)result * p % MOD;
    } else {
        DSU dsu(p);
        for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i)
            dsu.unite(i, (ll)k * i % p);
        int components = (k > 1) ? dsu.comp : p - dsu.sz.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < components; ++i)
            result = (ll)result * p % MOD;
    }

    cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}
